subject: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medisys.com>, Jing Li <jing.li@medisys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

Hi Anita / Jing,

As discussed on the call, please find an initial proposal for the private-deployment data-surface map and a BYOK access-role matrix attached. Key asks from your side:

- Confirm scope: which of the three ingestion paths (API, batch SFTP, partner webhook) you want scoped into the private deployment evidence set.
- Tell us any additional telemetry or audit windows (we proposed 90 days for operator telemetry; you indicated you might need 180).
- Legal: Jing, if you can flag any DPA redline items in the attached doc and add priority items (e.g., escrow wording, operator breakglass triggers) that would be helpful.

Quick summary of what we attached:
- privdep_data_surface_map_v1.pdf — diagram with data flow lanes (customer VPC, Redwood control plane, operator telemetry collector).
- byok_access_matrix_v2.xlsx — suggested role-level access for CMK operations, operator service accounts, emergency breakglass.
- dpa_redlines_initial.docx — our starting redline focused on custody, telemetry retention, and subprocessor notification cadence.

Proposed next step: a short sync on Friday (30 mins) to walk the surface map and agree on what counts as \"customer controlled data\" vs telemetry. I can host — proposed windows: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00 PST.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Enterprise Privacy
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachment stubs: privdep_data_surface_map_v1.pdf (diagram), byok_access_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), dpa_redlines_initial.docx (word doc)
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medisys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jing Li <jing.li@medisys.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

Thanks Priyom — reviewing now. A few quick items from initial read:

1) Ingestion scope: we definitely need API and SFTP included. Partner webhook — only for the partner subset; we can mark that as out-of-scope for the first phase.
2) Telemetry retention: Clinical QA team requires 180 days of operator telemetry (for incident replay). Is that something Redwood can support by config at customer level?
3) BYOK: we need the ability to rotate CMKs without Redwood having a backdoor. The access matrix you shared looks promising but can you add explicit entitlements for the CUSTOMER-KMS-ADMIN role (key import, rotate, revoke) and show that logs are only written to our KMS audit channel?

I will ask Jing to flag DPA-level redlines. Can we do the Friday slot at 10:00 PST? Tom from procurement will join to confirm procurement steps.

-Anita
Anita Rao
Head of Security Programs
Medisys Health
Anita.Rao@medisys.com
From: Jing Li <jing.li@medisys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@medisys.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

Priyom — initial legal notes inline in the doc. High-level:

- Escrow: suggest adding an escrow-trigger carveout for insolvency and for formal regulatory subpoena. The wording should require Redwood to notify 10 business days prior to escrow transfer.
- Subprocessors: we need a 14-day notification window for new subprocessors that may touch telemetry or run operator orchestration in our region.
- Audit: Medisys requires quarterly evidence samples for the first year (not just on-demand). Please confirm Redwood's ability to provide those samples (redacted) in a 7-business-day window.

I can review more after the Friday sync.

Best,
Jing Li
Senior Counsel, Compliance
Medisys Health
jing.li@medisys.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medisys.com>, Jing Li <jing.li@medisys.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

Thanks — confirmed for Friday 10:00 PST. Short notes for internal attendees:

- Telemetry retention: Anita is requesting 180 days. Irene — can the operator telemetry retention be configured per-customer to 180d without impacting cost ceilings? If not, what's the fallback (e.g., export-only after 90d)?
- BYOK operations: Karthik — please prepare the updated access matrix showing CUSTOMER-KMS-ADMIN entitlements and how Redwood operator accounts are prevented from having key-decrypt privileges.
- Audit samples: Ben — we need a runbook to produce quarterly evidence samples within 7 business days; include redaction guidance and who signs off.

I'll host the Google Meet and upload slide snippets to the Drive link.

— Priyom
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

Priyom / team,

Quick feasibility notes after a brief infra check:

- Retention: We can support per-customer operator telemetry retention up to 365 days, but the default pipeline keeps hot logs for 90 days; beyond that we tier to compressed cold storage with longer retrieval latencies. That aligns with Anita's 180-day ask; we'll document retrieval SLAs (expected: 24–72 hours for archived telemetry).
- Key separation: We can implement the CUSTOMER-KMS-ADMIN as a distinct entitlement. Redwood operator accounts will have metadata-only references to key IDs but will not have Encrypt/Decrypt/Import/Export privileges. All key operations are proxied through the customer's KMS endpoint.
- Audit generation: Ben, I suggest a template with anonymization masks and sample extraction queries; the first quarterly pack will be manually validated by infra and compliance.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: PrivDep data-surface map + BYOK access roles — proposal and audit ask

All — follow-up from today's sync and action items summarized below. Including expected delivery dates.

Action items:
- Karthik: update and share BYOK access matrix with explicit CUSTOMER-KMS-ADMIN entitlements and operator role prohibitions. Due: 2026-11-24.
- Irene: write retrieval SLA blurb for archived telemetry (24–72h) and include expected storage cost delta. Due: 2026-11-25.
- Priyom: update DPA redlines with escrow notify window (10 business days) and subprocessor notification (14 days) and send a consolidated redline back to Jing. Due: 2026-11-23.
- Ben: produce a draft audit sample template and redaction rules. Due: 2026-11-24.

We've noted Medisys' procurement ask — Tom (copied) will share PO path; procurement expects standard master services terms + this DPA addendum. Priyom, once we have the updated matrix and the DPA redline I will own the evidence runbook and produce the first-quarter sample template for review.

Thanks, everyone.

Ben Carter
